description: This class defines a custom Liquibase change set for enabling triggers on all tables within a database schema. It implements the CustomTaskChange interface for executing raw SQL statements to alter database tables.

classes.name: EnableTriggersChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change class that enables triggers for all tables in the current database schema.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes SQL commands to enable all triggers for each table in the database schema.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the completion of the trigger enabling process.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the ResourceAccessor, currently not implemented.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validation method returning an empty ValidationErrors object.
